draft.title: Chiron opposite North Node
draft.humanMoment: A museum returns a ceremonial object to an Indigenous community just as a descendant conservator is hired to repair damage caused during its removal.
draft.developmentDetail: Museum officials retain the conservation records while community custodians insist that the handover include a full account of what happened to the object.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Chiron brings the unresolved damage and the knowledge required to treat it, while the North Node brings the return and the next chapter of custody that depends on that repair.
draft.aspectMechanic: The opposition places museum officials holding the records across from community custodians directing the return, so neither the repair nor the transfer can be edited out of the outcome.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the handover proceeds before the repair terms are settled, the object can be formally returned while its damage remains embedded in the dispute over its care.

judge.weakest: If the handover proceeds before the repair terms are settled, the object can be formally returned while its damage remains embedded in the dispute over its care.
judge.why: The consequence is slightly more abstract than the other fields, but it still follows concretely from the unsettled repair and custody conflict.
